summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of alternate director Jennifer K. Mann, appointed by Series D shareholders (linked to The Coca-Cola Company), and the appointment of Sedef Salingan Sahin as her replacement effective June 12, 2026. The filing is an ordinary board change with no structural impact, stake alteration, or special committee involvement. It is a routine governance update with no financial terms or event-driven premium. Watch for continuing board alignment with The Coca-Cola Company's representation.
